note: The IPC contract through a fake hs on PATH (opt/arngz/test/fixtures/fake-hs): the request file holds exactly verb, desk and options; hs runs dofile(<module>).run(<request>); the CLI renders the response's report line for line; an absent hs, an hs that never answers (ARNGZ_HS_TIMEOUT=1), one that exits with no response, exit 69, exit 65 and an engine error are each refused by name, exit 2.
